series.title: 连接池耗尽：慢报表与超时分支泄漏
series.premise: 订单API请求排队，应用连接池上限40。先检查连接占用和数据库活动，再分别验证慢查询与超时分支未归还连接的假设。
series.outcome: 暂停非必要报表并限流，滚动排空一台工作实例后恢复连接。隔离复现确认超时分支未归还连接，修复通过灰度；报表优化和池占用告警仍有明确负责人。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 已借出尚未归还的连接
连接未归还造成的泄漏
有长度上限的请求队列
停止向工作实例分派新请求并排空
超时后的资源清理分支
积压请求正在被处理完

recycling.note: 后续候选回访不算实际出现；本文件复现仅引用p001-p350或此前本场景已引入表达。

dialogues.title: 请求堆积
dialogues.premise: 订单API延迟上升，先确认等待发生在哪一层。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分等待连接和查询正在执行。

lines.en: The pool is exhausted on orders. The error rate spiked after nine.
lines.zh: 订单服务连接池耗尽，九点后错误率猛涨。

lines.en: Are requests waiting for connections? Or already running inside the database?
lines.zh: 请求在等连接，还是已在数据库里执行？

lines.en: Mostly waiting before any query starts. About two hundred requests are queued.
lines.zh: 大部分还没开始查询就卡住了，大约两百个请求在排队。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, writes still succeed, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，写入仍有成功的，对吧？

lines.en: Some do, but clients time out. Don't assume failed responses mean failed writes.
lines.zh: 有些成功，但客户端超时。不能把响应失败等同于写入失败。

lines.en: Let me tail the log first. I'll separate checkout waits from execution.
lines.zh: 我先盯日志，把借连接等待和执行耗时分开。

lines.en: Good. Keep client retries bounded too. Repeated writes could make this worse.
lines.zh: 好，也限制客户端重试。重复写入可能让问题更严重。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for evidence? A rough estimate will help us.
lines.zh: 那预计多久有证据？给个大概时间便于安排。

lines.en: I'll check duplicate order protection now. We need that before suggesting retries.
lines.zh: 我现在检查订单去重保护，建议重试前必须确认。

lines.en: About two minutes for pool metrics. No database restart while we're checking.
lines.zh: 连接池指标大约两分钟拿到，检查期间不重启数据库。

dialogues.title: 借出不等于正在查询
dialogues.premise: 排队发生在获取连接前，开始对照池状态与数据库会话。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出池借出计数与活跃查询数不是同一指标。

lines.en: Forty checked-out connections, none available now. The pool is exhausted across three workers.
lines.zh: 四十条连接全部借出，没有可用连接，三台工作实例的池都耗尽了。

lines.en: Does checked out mean running queries? Compare that with actual session activity.
lines.zh: 借出就代表在执行查询吗？和实际会话活动对照一下。

lines.en: No, ownership stays with the application. Some borrowed connections aren't executing anything.
lines.zh: 不是，连接仍由应用持有，有些借出的连接没有执行任何操作。

lines.en: Just to confirm, same workers, right? Don't mix global and local counts.
lines.zh: 确认一下，对照的是同一批实例，对吧？别混用全局和局部计数。

lines.en: Exactly. The database isn't at capacity. Raising every pool limit could overload it.
lines.zh: 对，数据库并未满载。把每个池上限都调高可能压垮数据库。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for mapping. I'll match session IDs to workers.
lines.zh: 好，我来做映射，把会话ID对应到工作实例。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on waits. We need ages, not just counts.
lines.zh: 我会观察等待情况，需要占用时长，不只是数量。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis has two branches. Slow work or connections never returned.
lines.zh: 当前假设有两个方向：执行太慢，或者连接从未归还。

lines.en: Idle sessions alone don't prove leakage. Pools normally keep idle sessions open.
lines.zh: 空闲会话本身不能证明泄漏，池通常会保留空闲会话。

lines.en: So, collect ownership and age together. Maybe both causes are contributing here.
lines.zh: 那就一起收集持有者和占用时长，也许两种原因都存在。

dialogues.title: 慢报表是真问题，但不是全部
dialogues.premise: 池已借满，数据库并非满载；先定位长时间运行的查询。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别慢查询能解释多少连接占用。

lines.en: Query execution time reached thirty seconds. Six report queries are still running.
lines.zh: 查询耗时达到三十秒，还有六条报表查询在执行。

lines.en: That explains six occupied connections today. What explains the other borrowed ones?
lines.zh: 这能解释六条连接被占用，其他借出的连接怎么解释？

lines.en: Not those reports, from this sample. Several checked-out connections have no owner.
lines.zh: 从这份样本看不是报表，有几条借出的连接已找不到请求持有者。

lines.en: So, don't rule that out yet. Reports still make timeouts more likely, right?
lines.zh: 所以别排除报表因素，它仍会增加超时概率，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. Match each timeout to ownership. A slow query isn't a leak.
lines.zh: 对，把每次超时和连接持有关系对应起来。慢查询不等于泄漏。

lines.en: The report scans old order rows. Maybe its missing filter explains that.
lines.zh: 报表扫描旧订单行，可能是漏掉筛选条件导致的。

lines.en: Check the plan before adding indexes. Today's incident isn't an indexing window.
lines.zh: 加索引前先查执行计划，今天的故障处理不是建索引窗口。

lines.en: A rushed index? Let's park that. What's the ETA for timeout traces?
lines.zh: 临时赶建索引先放一边，超时链路预计多久拿到？

lines.en: Two minutes with sampled request IDs. I'll avoid collecting customer payloads here.
lines.zh: 用采样请求ID，两分钟。我会避免收集客户业务内容。

lines.en: Okay, the working hypothesis stays split. We'll inspect the cancellation branch next.
lines.zh: 好，继续保留两个假设方向，下一步检查取消请求的分支。

dialogues.title: 超时后谁归还连接
dialogues.premise: 六条慢报表不能解释全部占用；检查请求超时后的连接持有记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出泄漏的证据强度和待复现条件。

lines.en: A connection leak looks possible here. Timed-out requests don't record a return.
lines.zh: 这里可能存在连接泄漏，超时请求没有记录连接归还。

lines.en: Could that be missing logging instead? We need a controlled cancellation test.
lines.zh: 会不会只是漏记日志？需要受控的取消测试。

lines.en: Yes, it's a working hypothesis now. Query execution time alone can't prove it.
lines.zh: 对，现在只是工作假设，查询耗时本身不能证明泄漏。

lines.en: Just to confirm, isolated testing, right? Don't inject cancellations into live orders.
lines.zh: 确认一下，在隔离环境测，对吧？别对线上订单注入取消操作。

lines.en: Agreed. Save current metrics before mitigation. We can recover without proving everything.
lines.zh: 同意，缓解前保存指标，不必查清所有问题才恢复服务。

lines.en: Okay, I'm on it for reproduction. Same client version, synthetic orders only.
lines.zh: 好，我负责复现，使用同版本客户端和合成订单。

lines.en: I'll compare successful and cancelled requests. Both must release their borrowed resources.
lines.zh: 我会对比成功和取消请求，两种都必须释放借用资源。

lines.en: The root cause is still open. Maybe report delays expose this branch.
lines.zh: 根因仍未定，可能报表延迟让这个分支更容易被触发。

lines.en: That's plausible, but not confirmed yet. We need separate evidence for each link.
lines.zh: 合理，但还没确认，因果链的每一环都需要各自证据。

lines.en: So, first contain the request backlog. Then test that link without pressure.
lines.zh: 那先控制请求积压，再在没有线上压力的条件下验证因果联系。

dialogues.title: 限制队列，而不是无限加连接
dialogues.premise: 慢报表和泄漏假设并存，先决定有边界的缓解措施。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住限流对象、重试约束和不能恢复泄漏连接的原因。

lines.en: Use a bounded request queue here. Reject excess work before borrowing connections.
lines.zh: 这里使用有上限的请求队列，借连接之前拒绝超额工作。

lines.en: Okay, shed load from reports first. Keep order writes within safe limits.
lines.zh: 好，先减掉报表负载，让订单写入维持安全限额。

lines.en: That should buy us time today. But it won't reclaim a connection leak.
lines.zh: 这能为今天争取时间，但不能收回泄漏的连接。

lines.en: Correct. Tell clients to back off. A rejection shouldn't trigger endless retries.
lines.zh: 对，告诉客户端退避，被拒绝不应触发无限重试。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports pause, right? Existing writes get time to finish.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表暂停，对吧？给已有写入完成的时间。

lines.en: Yes, through the approved feature control. Don't kill every database session instead.
lines.zh: 是，通过批准的功能控制暂停，不是杀掉所有数据库会话。

lines.en: What's our rollback trigger for limits? Maybe legitimate orders start failing faster.
lines.zh: 限流的回退触发条件是什么？正常订单可能反而更快失败。

lines.en: Compare accepted writes and rejection counts. Stop tightening if useful throughput drops.
lines.zh: 对比成功接纳的写入和拒绝数，有效吞吐下降就别继续收紧。

lines.en: So, apply the limit on one worker. I'll verify idempotent retries with support.
lines.zh: 那先在一台实例施加限额，我和支持团队确认幂等重试。

lines.en: I'll watch database load during that. Then we can safely rotate workers.
lines.zh: 我在此期间观察数据库负载，之后才能安全滚动处理实例。

dialogues.title: 逐台排空并重建应用池
dialogues.premise: 报表暂停且单实例限流验证通过，准备回收滞留连接。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区别应用实例排空与重启整个数据库。

lines.en: I'll drain the worker marked A. New requests now go elsewhere safely.
lines.zh: 我排空A实例，新请求现在安全地送往其他实例。

lines.en: Do the remaining workers have capacity? Keep the bounded request queue enabled.
lines.zh: 其他实例有容量吗？有上限的请求队列继续启用。

lines.en: Yes, the lower traffic fits now. About five writes remain on A.
lines.zh: 有，降低后的流量现在能承受，A上还有大约五笔写入。

lines.en: Okay, wait for those writes, right? This is still a temporary workaround.
lines.zh: 好，等那些写入结束，对吧？这仍是临时缓解。

lines.en: Check outcomes before closing the pool. Cancellation doesn't guarantee a transaction stopped.
lines.zh: 关闭池之前检查结果，取消请求不能保证事务已停止。

lines.en: The five writes have completed now. I'll restart this application worker next.
lines.zh: 五笔写入现在都完成了，接下来重启这台应用实例。

lines.en: Not the database. Keep that distinction. I'll keep an eye on routing.
lines.zh: 不是重启数据库，要区分清楚。我会观察路由。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for checks? Maybe two minutes before another worker.
lines.zh: 检查预计多久？也许等两分钟再处理另一台。

lines.en: Two minutes after A returns healthy. Verify fresh writes and connection releases.
lines.zh: A恢复健康后两分钟，验证新写入和连接释放。

lines.en: I'm on it for session counts. We'll stop if database connections surge.
lines.zh: 我负责会话数，数据库连接暴涨就停止。

dialogues.title: 连接能借到，但修复尚未完成
dialogues.premise: 逐台排空重启结束，限流和报表暂停仍保持。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解指标恢复不能证明泄漏修好了。

lines.en: Connection checkout time is normal again. Each worker has available connections now.
lines.zh: 借连接等待恢复正常，每台实例现在都有可用连接。

lines.en: What about checked-out connections over time? A fresh pool can hide leakage.
lines.zh: 借出连接随时间怎么变化？新建池可能掩盖泄漏。

lines.en: They're stable under the reduced traffic. That doesn't prove cancellation is fixed.
lines.zh: 在降低流量后计数稳定，但不代表取消分支修好了。

lines.en: Just to confirm, reports stay paused, right? Don't remove both safeguards together.
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表仍暂停，对吧？别同时撤掉两种保护。

lines.en: Agreed. We're back to baseline now. State the limits with that update.
lines.zh: 同意，现在回到基线，更新时要一并说明限流仍在。

lines.en: If the pool is exhausted again, stop. Maybe another path holds connections too.
lines.zh: 如果池再耗尽就停止，也许还有其他分支持有连接。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation tonight. Track connection age beside checkout waits.
lines.zh: 今晚继续观察，连接占用时长和借连接等待一起跟踪。

lines.en: Okay, isolated testing is running now. The first cancelled request retained ownership.
lines.zh: 好，隔离测试在进行，首个被取消请求仍持有连接。

lines.en: Repeat it against the current release. One sample isn't the complete diagnosis.
lines.zh: 针对当前发布版本重复测试，一份样本不是完整诊断。

lines.en: So, keep recovery and repair separate. We'll review that test evidence next.
lines.zh: 那就把恢复和修复分开，下一步评审测试证据。

dialogues.title: 复现超时清理缺口
dialogues.premise: 线上指标恢复，隔离测试继续验证取消后连接未归还。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出已确认的代码缺陷和仍待完成的报表优化。

lines.en: The timeout cleanup path misses release. Ten cancellations retained ten borrowed connections.
lines.zh: 超时清理分支漏掉释放，十次取消滞留了十条借用连接。

lines.en: Did normal requests release them correctly? We need the successful control too.
lines.zh: 正常请求能正确释放吗？也需要成功请求的对照。

lines.en: Yes, normal requests return them consistently. That confirms this connection leak now.
lines.zh: 能，正常请求稳定归还连接，现在确认了这一处泄漏。

lines.en: Okay, test exceptions as well, right? Maybe cancellation isn't the sole broken branch.
lines.zh: 好，也测试异常分支，对吧？取消可能不是唯一有问题的分支。

lines.en: And check open transaction cleanup separately. Returning a dirty connection isn't safe.
lines.zh: 还要单独检查未结束事务的清理，归还带事务状态的连接不安全。

lines.en: I'm on it with structured cleanup. Release follows transaction outcome handling now.
lines.zh: 我用结构化清理修复，现在处理好事务结果后才释放连接。

lines.en: The smoke test must include timeouts. Healthy requests alone won't cover this.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试必须包括超时，只有正常请求覆盖不到这里。

lines.en: Query execution time remains a separate issue. Reports still need their filter reviewed.
lines.zh: 查询耗时仍是单独的问题，报表筛选条件仍需评审。

lines.en: Keep that action item after mitigation. Don't bundle an untested query rewrite.
lines.zh: 缓解后保留这个行动项，别捆绑未经测试的查询重写。

lines.en: So, stage the cleanup fix first. Reports resume only after separate validation.
lines.zh: 那先灰度清理修复，报表要单独验证后才恢复。

dialogues.title: 恢复状态不掩盖剩余限制
dialogues.premise: 清理修复通过隔离测试和单实例灰度，订单指标稳定，报表仍暂停。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分辨客户可见恢复、修复灰度和未恢复功能。

lines.en: Requests are draining without new buildup. Support can report order processing recovered.
lines.zh: 请求积压正在消化，没有新增堆积，支持团队可报告订单处理恢复。

lines.en: Include which functions remain restricted now. Reports are still unavailable to users.
lines.zh: 写清哪些功能仍受限，用户目前仍不能使用报表。

lines.en: Connection checkout time stays near baseline. The cleanup canary passed cancellation checks.
lines.zh: 借连接等待保持接近基线，清理修复的灰度通过取消测试。

lines.en: Okay, no full repair claim, right? The temporary workaround still includes limits.
lines.zh: 好，别宣称全部修好，对吧？临时缓解还包括限流。

lines.en: Yes. Expand the fix in batches. Observe each batch before relaxing limits.
lines.zh: 对，分批扩展修复，每批观察后才放宽限额。

lines.en: What's the ETA for report recovery? Maybe tomorrow after the query review.
lines.zh: 报表恢复预计什么时候？也许明天查询评审后。

lines.en: Call that an estimate, not commitment. Include the escalation path for regressions.
lines.zh: 说明这是估计，不是承诺，也写上回归异常的升级联系路径。

lines.en: So, circle back in thirty minutes. Earlier if waiting requests start rising.
lines.zh: 那三十分钟后再更新，等待请求上升就提前。

lines.en: I'll watch accepted throughput during expansion. Low errors with fewer orders isn't recovery.
lines.zh: 我在扩展时观察有效吞吐，订单少了而错误低不算恢复。

lines.en: Agreed, throughput matches the expected demand. I'll attach that evidence to support.
lines.zh: 同意，吞吐符合预期需求，我把证据附给支持团队。

dialogues.title: 把清理保证写进测试
dialogues.premise: 清理修复已分批完成，限额逐步放宽且稳定，报表优化仍待验收。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住代码、查询和监控三类任务的负责人及期限。

lines.en: Every exit must return the connection. The timeout cleanup path now does.
lines.zh: 每个退出分支都必须归还连接，超时清理分支现在也做到了。

lines.en: After resolving transaction state, of course. Tests must enforce that ordering too.
lines.zh: 当然要先处理事务状态，测试也必须保证这个顺序。

lines.en: Okay, checked-out connections need age alerts. Counts alone hid abandoned ownership here.
lines.zh: 好，借出连接需要占用时长告警，这次只看数量掩盖了持有关系丢失。

lines.en: Who's picking this up by Friday? Hannah, you own those alerts, right?
lines.zh: 谁周五前接这个任务？Hannah，告警由你负责，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, with a bounded cancellation test. I'll compare occupancy before and after.
lines.zh: 是，也加上有上限的取消测试，对比前后占用。

lines.en: My action item is regression coverage. I'll add exception cases by tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我的行动项是回归覆盖，明天前加上异常场景。

lines.en: I'll review retry limits with clients. Maybe our timeout budget needs adjustment.
lines.zh: 我和客户端评审重试限额，可能超时预算也需要调整。

lines.en: I'll review the report plan tomorrow. Slow reports triggered waits, not every leak.
lines.zh: 我明天评审报表执行计划，慢报表引发等待，但并非所有泄漏都由它解释。

lines.en: Report recovery needs its own evidence. Keep that acceptance separate from cleanup.
lines.zh: 报表恢复要有自己的证据，验收与连接清理分开。

lines.en: So, close the loop next Friday. Bring test results, not just closed tickets.
lines.zh: 那下周五闭环，带测试结果，不只是关闭的工单。
